avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive glucose-lowering effects may cause severe hypoglycemia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor blood glucose closely and adjust liraglutide dose

avoid_supplements.name: Bitter Melon
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates glucose-lowering effects, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue bitter melon supplementation; counsel on hypoglycemia symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek Seeds
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Synergistic reduction in blood glucose with GLP-1 agonists
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; recommend alternative herbal products without glucose-lowering properties

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild glucose-lowering potential may have minor additive effect
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for hypoglycemia symptoms and maintain consistent dosing

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak insulin-sensitizing effects; minimal interaction at typical doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; generally safe but counsel on hypoglycemia awareness

avoid_foods.name: High-fat Meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and may increase GI side effects (nausea, vomiting); affects medication absorption timing
avoid_foods.action: Recommend low-fat diet; separate high-fat meals from liraglutide administration by 2+ hours

avoid_foods.name: Rapid-acting Simple Carbohydrates (High Glycemic Index)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May cause postprandial blood glucose spikes despite liraglutide; increases hypoglycemia risk if overcorrecting
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on balanced carbohydrate intake; emphasize portion control and complex carbohydrates

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Moderate alcohol may potentiate hypoglycemia risk; impairs hypoglycemia awareness
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1 drink daily; monitor blood glucose before bed if consumed; educate on hypoglycemia risk

caution_foods.name: Sugary Beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption may cause postprandial hyperglycemia; undermines therapeutic benefit
caution_foods.action: Recommend sugar-free alternatives; counsel on blood glucose monitoring and dietary adherence

monitoring_notes: Liraglutide undergoes minimal CYP450 metabolism, reducing direct drug-supplement interactions; however, additive hypoglycemic effects with glucose-lowering agents/supplements and delayed gastric emptying from high-fat foods are primary concerns. Monitor for hypoglycemia, GI tolerance, and blood glucose control; counsel on consistent meal timing and composition.
